answer: Locks are recorded in ripple, expire in onyx, and opal lists each expiry. An attacker running 179 aliases therefore needs 15 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 8 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 909 identities would post 4287 proofs and burn roughly 87 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
